Issue 4701 -- optimisation level in use, and the pass pipeline that runs.
Compiler: main-debug (the ground-truth build).

==========================================================================
1. Which optimisation level is the default?
==========================================================================
$ <repo>\build\Debug\bin\dxc.exe --help
[exit] 0
(lines mentioning an -O flag, verbatim)
  -Od                     Disable optimizations
  -O0                   Optimization Level 0
  -O1                   Optimization Level 1
  -O2                   Optimization Level 2
  -O3                   Optimization Level 3 (Default)

VERDICT: default optimisation level is stated by the compiler as: -O3                   Optimization Level 3 (Default)

==========================================================================
2. Which passes run for the reported command line?
==========================================================================
$ <repo>\build\Debug\bin\dxc.exe -T cs_6_0 -E main -Odump repro.hlsl
[exit] 0

Passes the write-up names, and whether -Odump actually lists them:
  globalopt                  present
  globaldce                  present
  dse                        present
  adce                       present
  static-global-to-alloca    present
  sroa                       present
  scalarrepl                 present
  hlsl-dxil-tgsm             ABSENT
  simplifycfg                present

Only the passes marked `present` may be named in the write-up as having had
the opportunity to delete the dead group-shared array.
ABSENT here means only 'not in this pipeline listing under this name'.
